description: Figures 3, 12, 13. curves: held-out R^2 of fact-address (order-of-mention) and person templates of the query-dependent states, by block. answer_alignment: cosine of each query-dependent state with its own answer's direction, by block. projection: test-word-set states at the main block in the first two principal directions of the four fact-address templates (template_xyz), points labeled by order of mention (0-based) and person; context indexes the contexts. interaction: per-context cosine between the measured person x relation interaction and the one predicted by fact addresses (Lemma E.1), and the same under the 23 relabelings of the orders of mention (relabeled).
